narr: A cold front moved approached New Hampshire from the west, bringing a line of showers and thunderstorms. The environment was a continuation of an anomalously moist airmass supportive of torrential rainfall. Ground conditions across New Hampshire were growing saturated, and streams were running high. The storms that developed on the evening of the 13th were concentrated across southwest New Hampshire.
ev: Heavy rain moved into Cheshire County around 8 PM with rainfall rates peaking around 4 inches an hour. In Walpole, Great Brook came out of banks and flooded Old Keene Road near Mill Road and damaged agricultural property off Watkins Hill Road.
